feeds.title: Bacon's Rebellion
feeds.description: Bacon's Rebellion is Virginia's leading politically non-aligned portal for news, opinions, and analysis about the state, regional, and local public policy. Our mission is to provide Virginia citizens with the ideas and news they need to build more prosperous, livable, and sustainable communities.

feeds.title: The Virginia Mercury
feeds.description: Read the latest news briefs, commentary, and Op-ed articles covering Virginia. The Virginia Mercury is an independent, nonprofit online news organization covering state government and policy. Launched in 2018, The Mercury brings a fresh perspective to coverage of the state's biggest political and policy issues.

feeds.title: WAVY.com » Virginia Politics
feeds.description: The latest news and updates in Virginia politics are brought to you by the team at WAVY.com. WAVY.com is Hampton Roads TV website, known and respected for breaking news, weather sports, and streaming video. The site serves as the interactive portal for The Hampton Roads Show with live streaming and online chat.

feeds.title: WTVR.com » Virginia Politics
feeds.description: Stay posted on the political news, elections, and more from Virginia. On air since April 22, 1948, WTVR-TV, the South's First Television Station located on West Broad Street in Richmond, Virginia, is a legacy CBS affiliate owned by the E. W. Scripps Company.

feeds.title: Blue Virginia
feeds.description: The purpose of Blue Virginia is to cover Virginia politics from a progressive and Democratic perspective and to help elect Democrats. This is a group blog that shares views about the politics of Virginia from different points of view.

feeds.title: The Virginian-Pilot » Virginia Government & Politics
feeds.description: Find in-depth coverage and breaking news on the Virginia governor, General Assembly, Supreme Court of Virginia, and more. The Virginian-Pilot is a media publishing company that covers news from all over the state of Virginia.

feeds.title: RVA Politics
feeds.description: this political blog is based in Richmond, VA, and read about local, city, and state politics. Richard Meagher is the brain behind RVA politics. He teaches politics at Randolph-Macon College in Ashland, VA.

feeds.title: Free Virginia
feeds.description: Marc Montoni, a network consultant & installer, is the writer behind Free Virginia blog. He writes commentary on Virginia politics from a Libertarian perspective.

feeds.title: David J. Toscano Blog
feeds.description: David J. Toscano served seven terms in the Virginia House of Delegates representing the 57th District. His priorities included education, renewable energy, and the environment. He writes about the political scene of Virginia.

feeds.title: Blue Virginia
feeds.description: The purpose of Blue Virginia is to cover Virginia politics from a progressive and Democratic perspective. This is a group blog that shares views about the politics of Virginia from different points of view.

feeds.title: Bearing Drift
feeds.description: Bearing Drift was founded in 2004 by J.R. Hoeft and is Virginia's premiere conservative website. It is part of the Virginia Line Media LLC group, which includes The Jeffersoniad website, and our regionally syndicated radio show The Score. We keep you posted on the political scene of Virginia.
